Class Board

java.lang.Object
mesos.board.Board
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Board extends Object implements Serializable
Aggregate root for the shared game-area state: the two visible rows, the Offer Track, the Turn Order Tile, the tribe deck and the per-era building decks. Deck construction is delegated to TribeDeckFactory and BuildingDeckFactory; this class only orchestrates them.

    • refillTopRow

      public RowRefillResult refillTopRow(PlayerCount playerCount, Era currentEra)
      Performs the end-of-round row refill: discards bottom non-building cards, slides top non-building cards down, then draws from the tribe deck to refill the top row.
      Parameters:
      playerCount - the current player count (determines required top-row size)
      currentEra - the current era (used to detect era transitions)
      Returns:
      a RowRefillResult describing any era transition and whether the deck is exhausted
